00209.clinical_review: Confirm indication and course duration. Adjuvant colon therapy is usually 12 fortnightly cycles, with six an option for T1–3 N1 disease. Metastatic colon treatment and the advanced gastric or gastro-oesophageal junction course have separate stopping criteria in the NCCP protocol.

00227.clinical_review: Confirm which FOLFIRI indication is prescribed. Check the planned early response review. NCCP specifies discontinuation if there is no response after two cycles. Document the 46-hour pump disconnection and the distinct early and delayed irinotecan diarrhoea instructions.

00321.clinical_review: Confirm the capecitabine calendar: twice daily on days 1–14, with no tablets on days 15–21. Distinguish the planned four or eight adjuvant cycles from treatment in metastatic disease. Reconcile the written tablet plan after any delay.

00344.clinical_review: Review perioperative FLOT by phase. Plan the 24-hour fluorouracil pump disconnection and reconcile the docetaxel steroid premedication with the antiemetic steroid. The postoperative course requires a fresh assessment after surgery.

00897.clinical_review: Document whether the visit is day 1 or day 8 of combination therapy, or durvalumab maintenance. Gemcitabine and cisplatin stop after up to eight 21-day cycles. From cycle 9 durvalumab alone follows a 28-day cycle if appropriate.
